findings.title: PR body claims every existing .log.bin diff is version/hash-only; qos_emphasis.log.bin payload bytes change
findings.evidence: pr-body.md: "+- **Golden fold (4.3 provable, not assumed):** every existing `.log.bin` / +   diff = the LOG_VERSION byte + the 8 catalog-hash bytes only". serialize.odin: "-LOG_VERSION :: u32(3) / +LOG_VERSION :: u32(4)" and "+-			w_u16(&w, c.preset) / ++			w_i32(&w, c.weights[0])" (2B -> 12B per record). In-diff transcript: "+ === qos_emphasis.log.bin === / + old 155B new 175B / + diff ranges: [(4, 5), (17, 25), (122, 123), (124, 125), (126, 127), (130, 131), (132, 135), (137, 138)]". serialize.odin's own comment: "+// re-bless with this story (version/hash-only for no-QoS runs; QoS-edit runs / +// re-bless the action-log bytes, which now carry weights)."
findings.detail: PR body says every existing .log.bin diff = version byte + catalog-hash bytes only; qos_emphasis.log.bin (existing QoS-edit demo) also re-encodes its 2 SET_EMPHASIS records (155→175B). Perkins independently byte-verified: fold is sound, claim scope is wrong.

findings.title: P1 gap: app-side QoS panel lifecycle (clobber gate, derived AUTO/MANUAL mode, revert-to-auto, auto-follow trigger) has zero test coverage at any tier
findings.detail: VERIFIED: no automated pin at any tier for the clobber gate / derived mode / revert / auto-follow (demos hand-pin outcomes). Demoted blocker→warning per repo precedent (5.7 r1: app-side zero coverage = warning): app layer's test story is T2 goldens; the P0 core contract (ladder, E6, serialization, replay) is 100% pinned; Perkins verified the gate logic correct by direct read.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract the mode/gate decisions into pure procs and pin them: manual pipe + assignment keeps weights; auto pipe assignment writes the ladder set; revert restores the ladder set.

findings.title: No v3-log rejection pin for the v4 reader despite the per-bump pin precedent; 5.8 is the first same-tag payload reinterpretation
findings.evidence: log_read gate (core/serialize.odin:564): `if r_u32(&r) != LOG_VERSION do return {}, nil, false`. Precedent pin (core/placement_test.odin:413-417): `// a version-2 log must reject cleanly (LOG_VERSION 3 — the 1.2→2 precedent:` / `// old logs are a defined rejection, never a silent partial parse)` / `v2 := make([]u8, len(bytes), context.temp_allocator)` / `copy(v2, bytes)` / `v2[4] = 2 // version field (second u32, little-endian)`. Generic pins only (core/determinism_test.odin:334,337): `// a future/unknown version field must reject (the 1.1 v1 log is rejected)` / `fut[4] = 99 // bump the version field (second u32, little-endian)`. The diff adds no v3-shaped rejection pin.
findings.detail: No v3-log rejection pin although every prior LOG_VERSION bump added one and 5.8 is the first same-tag payload reinterpretation (a future v3-compat shim would pass v2/v99 pins). Merged with tests#1.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a core test handcrafting a real v3 log (version-3 header + one preset-shaped tag-5 record, 6-byte payload) asserting log_read returns false, mirroring placement_test's v2 pin.

findings.title: P2 gap: app panel edge behaviors (never-drop zeroed-lane cycle guard, ±5 nudge clamping, preset bounds) have no tests
findings.evidence: app/qos_panel.odin:186-193 (read in the diff, new file, and verified at sha): `if never_drop {` / `ps, ok := pp.pipe_slot(&app.state.topology, u32(app.sel_pipe))` / `if !ok {` / `return` / `}` / `if app.state.topology.pipe_weights[ps][next] == 0 {` / `continue` / `}` — the cycle deadlock guard. app/qos_panel.odin:223: `nv = max(0, min(pp.MAX_WEIGHT, nv))` — the ±5 clamp. No test file references qos_cycle_class_lane or qos_nudge (`grep -rn "qos_cycle_class_lane|qos_nudge" app/*_test.odin core/*_test.odin` → no matches; no app test files exist).
findings.detail: The cycle guard was a review-driven fix (never-drop class deadlocking on a zeroed lane); the nudge clamp is the manual editor's only domain bound. Both are unpinned — P2 behaviors with zero coverage.
findings.recommended_fix: Pin the extracted helpers: cycle offers only positive-weight lanes for never-drop classes (all-zeroed → Invalid_Weights); nudge clamps at 0 and MAX_WEIGHT; out-of-range preset is a no-op.

findings.title: Spec leaves the golden re-bless task unchecked while the PR ships it
findings.evidence: spec: "+- [ ] goldens -- mechanical re-bless with the 4.3 provable-fold proof -- \"no-QoS runs MUST NOT shift\"". golden-manifest.txt: "-catalog_hash a7b85c806df0397c" -> "+catalog_hash bdc90b1363c93d8b" across every existing .t1, plus new "+++ b/goldens/qos_auto.t1" and "+++ b/goldens/qos_manual.t1". Spec also claims "+review_loop_iteration: 0" and an empty change log.

findings.recommended_fix: Tick the checkbox, bump the review-loop iteration, and append a change-log entry reflecting the re-bless and the review-driven code fixes.

findings.title: Spec's ladder constraints and signatures don't match the implemented validation
findings.evidence: spec: "+- Ladder is data-driven (`lane_auto_reserve_ladder` in balance.json, fail-fast validated, ODN-5), integer weights (ODN-10), `0 ≤ w ≤ MAX_WEIGHT`, never all-zero"; "+- `core/catalog.odin` -- `Balance` struct field + load/validation (fail-fast: rows by lane count, values 1..MAX_WEIGHT, sums, row ordering)"; "+- `core/qos.odin` -- new pure `qos_auto_weights(t, cat, pipe_slot, pipe_id) -> [3]i32`". Code: "+				if w64 < 1 || w64 > MAX_WEIGHT {" (rejects 0; no sum check exists) and "+qos_auto_weights :: proc(t: ^Topology, cat: ^Catalogs, pipe_id: u32) -> (w: [3]i32) {".
findings.detail: Spec says 0 ≤ w, promises sum validation, and lists a 4-parameter qos_auto_weights; the loader enforces 1..MAX_WEIGHT with no sum check and the proc takes 3 parameters.
findings.recommended_fix: Reconcile the spec wording (1..MAX_WEIGHT, drop 'sums', fix the signature) or implement the promised sum validation.

findings.title: qos_auto golden hand-pins the ladder output; the auto-follow path is never exercised end-to-end
findings.evidence: demos/qos_auto.dem: "+at 3000ms lane 1 streaming express / +at 3000ms lane 1 email best_effort / +at 3000ms weights 1 50 30 20" and comment "+# computed set through Cmd_Set_Emphasis (the `weights` directive pins the / +# SERIALIZED outcome; the ladder COMPUTATION itself is core-tested in / +# qos_test.odin)". determinism_test.odin gains only the fixture mirror: "+	cat.balance.auto_ladder = [3][3]i32{".
findings.detail: The 50/30/20 line is authored, not computed; retuning balance.json's ladder leaves this golden green with stale splits, and app set_lane_class→qos_apply_auto has no automated pin.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a harness directive that lowers lanes then computes qos_auto_weights for the emphasis command, or an app-level test of the auto-follow write decision.

findings.title: Harness lowers weights directives before lane directives, inverting demo-file and app command order
findings.evidence: run.odin inserted block: "+	for i in 0..<len(demo.weights) { / +		d := &demo.weights[i] / +		append(&state.action_log, pp.Command{ / +			apply_tick = apply_tick_at(d.at_ms, pauses, cat.balance.logic_hz), / +			kind = pp.Cmd_Set_Emphasis{pipe = d.pipe, weights = d.weights}, / +		}) / +	}" followed by unchanged context " 	for i in 0..<len(demo.lanes) {". demos/qos_auto.dem lists "+at 3000ms lane 1 streaming express" before "+at 3000ms weights 1 50 30 20".
findings.detail: Same-tick intents serialize weights-first though the .dem lists lanes first and the app writes lane→weights; the weights command's E6 validation runs against pre-assignment bindings.
findings.recommended_fix: Move the weights loop after the lanes loop, or sort same-tick intents by file order, to match the app's canonical sequence.

findings.title: Right-click passes through the QoS panel to the world beneath
findings.evidence: left-press swallow added: "+		if app.placing < 0 && qos_panel_click(app, {f32(mx), f32(my)}) { / +			app.press_swallowed = true / +			return / +		}". right-click path (same diff): "+		if pid, ok := pipe_hit(app, wx, wy); ok { / +			app.sel_pipe = i64(pid) / +			app.sel_node = -1 / +			app.sel_class = 0 / +			app.qos_editing = false // a fresh selection starts with the editor closed / +		}" — no panel hit-test.
findings.detail: Left presses inside qos_panel_rect are swallowed; right-clicks are not — button 2 over the panel re-selects pipes underneath and resets the open editor.
findings.recommended_fix: Hit-test qos_panel_rect in the right-click path and swallow (skip pipe_hit) when the click lands inside the panel.

findings.title: reject_label hardcodes the weight domain as '0..1000'
findings.evidence: "+	case .Invalid_Weights: return \"that weight set is invalid - lanes 0..1000, never all zero, never-drop lanes keep bandwidth\"" — while validation uses the constant: "+		if w[i] < 0 || w[i] > MAX_WEIGHT { return .Invalid_Weights }".
findings.detail: Duplicates MAX_WEIGHT as a literal in player-facing copy; the message silently lies if the constant is retuned. The diff never shows MAX_WEIGHT's value.
findings.recommended_fix: Format MAX_WEIGHT into the string instead of the hardcoded 1000.

findings.title: 'Second pipe is independent' assertion cannot fail — unknown pipe ids return the default preset
findings.evidence: test: "+	append(&s.action_log, Command{apply_tick = 1, kind = Cmd_Draw_Pipe{a = res, b = rt, tier = std}}) / +	step_n(&s, 1, cat) // applies the second draw — pipe id 1 / +	testing.expect_value(t, qos_auto_weights(&s.topology, cat, 1), [3]i32{1, 1, 1})". Core: "+	if !assigned { / +		// untouched pipe — the resting preset (byte-stable no-QoS runs) / +		return cat.balance.lane_presets[cat.balance.default_preset_idx].weights / +	}" — no pipe-existence check anywhere in qos_auto_weights.
findings.detail: If the duplicate res→rt draw is rejected, pipe 1 never exists, yet the expectation still passes via the untouched branch — the 'independence' pin is vacuous.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert pipe_slot(t, 1) exists before the expectation, or draw a genuinely distinct edge for the second pipe.

findings.title: Rejection toast draws on top of the panel's bottom button row
findings.evidence: "+		draw_text(app, reject_label(app.last_reject), QOS_PANEL_X + 10, i32(panel.y + panel.height) - 18, 14, rl.Color{200, 60, 60, 255})" with "+qos_panel_h :: proc(app: ^App) -> i32 { / +	n := 1 + 3 + i32(len(app.cat.packet_types)) + 1 // title + split + classes + actions / +	return 8 + n * QOS_ROW_H" and "+	y := qos_row_y(4 + i32(len(app.cat.packet_types)))" (actions/nudge row is the last row).

findings.title: [blind+codebase] Right-click select resets sel_class; click-select does not
findings.evidence: right-click hunk: "+			app.sel_class = 0". click_select hunk: " 	if pid, ok := pipe_hit(app, wx, wy); ok { / 		app.sel_pipe = i64(pid) / 		app.sel_node = -1 / +		app.qos_editing = false // a fresh selection starts with the editor closed / 		return / 	}" — sel_class untouched.
findings.detail: The two selection paths leave different 1/2 key-target classes, so the panel's highlighted row depends on how the pipe was selected.
findings.recommended_fix: Reset (or consistently preserve) sel_class in click_select to match the right-click path.

findings.title: [blind+tests] Ladder upper-bound branch (> MAX_WEIGHT) never exercised by fail-fast tests
findings.evidence: validation: "+				if w64 < 1 || w64 > MAX_WEIGHT { / +					return {\"balance.json\", \"lane_auto_reserve_ladder\", fmt.tprintf(\"row %d weight must be in 1..MAX_WEIGHT\", ri+1)}". Added cases cover missing/wrong-count/wrong-arity/zero/non-descending/non-int only: "+		{\"ladder zero share\", replace1(BAL_VALID, `[50, 30, 20]`, `[50, 30, 0]`, 1), \"must be in 1..MAX_WEIGHT\"}," — no above-MAX_WEIGHT case.
findings.detail: Only the lower bound (zero share) is pinned; the w64 > MAX_WEIGHT rejection branch has no test.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a fail-fast case with an above-MAX_WEIGHT ladder value (e.g. [50, 30, 1001]).

findings.title: Never-drop row cycle emits a logged self-assignment when the current lane is the only positive one
findings.detail: At step==LANE_COUNT, next==cur. A never-drop class on the only positive-weight lane skips both zeroed lanes, then self-assigns: set_lane_class validates, bumps gen, and logs a redundant Cmd_Set_Lane (app/qos_panel.odin:155) with no visible change; the terminal toast covers only all-zero weights.
findings.recommended_fix: Skip next==cur in the cycle (loop 1..<LANE_COUNT); when no different parkable lane exists, return without writing — or surface the reject toast — instead of logging the self-assignment.

findings.title: Panel button/chip text renders below the documented >= 14px legibility floor
findings.evidence: app/qos_panel.odin:398 `draw_text(app, btn0, i32(a0.x) + 8, i32(a0.y) + 1, 13, p.ink)`; :399 `draw_text(app, "Revert", i32(a1.x) + 8, i32(a1.y) + 1, 13, p.ink)`; :407 `draw_text(app, app.cat.balance.lane_presets[i].display, i32(chip.x) + 5, i32(chip.y) + 1, 12, p.ink)` vs pr-body.md:46 "panel uses the existing renderer at legible sizes (>= 14px)" and spec-5-8-qos-panel.md:104 "at legible sizes (≥14px), strong ink/ink_soft contrast on the cream canvas"
findings.detail: AC7's PR body and the spec's legibility note claim all panel text is >= 14px, but action buttons render at 13px and preset chips at 12px — the committed claim contradicts the code.
findings.recommended_fix: Bump buttons and chips to 14px, or correct the PR body / spec design-note wording to state the actual sizes used.

findings.title: MANUAL label flips on editor-open, contradicting the documented derived-mode definition
findings.evidence: app/qos_panel.odin:17-21 header: "The mode is DERIVED, never stored: a pipe is manual iff its current weights differ from qos_auto_weights(its assignments) — so no extra serialized state, and revert = write the auto set back. `qos_editing` (app-side UI state) only controls whether the editor rows are expanded." vs :92-94 `qos_mode_manual :: proc(app: ^App, ps: u32) -> bool { if app.qos_editing { return true }`
findings.detail: Opening [Edit weights] on an untouched AUTO pipe flips the title to MANUAL with zero weight changes, and the header comment claims qos_editing only expands rows — both contradict the briefing/PR-body iff-definition of manual.
findings.recommended_fix: Gate the MANUAL label on weights != auto only (keep editor-open gating the auto-follow), or amend the header comment and PR-body definition to document the editor-open override.

findings.title: New weights demo directive narrows the u64 pipe id to u32 without the range check it applies to the weight values in the same hunk
findings.detail: The hunk deliberately range-checks weight values before narrowing, citing silent-wrap risk, but casts the u64 pipe id to u32 unchecked: an id >= 2^32 wraps to a different pipe. First-party demo fixtures and downstream Missing_Pipe/golden gates fail loud, so impact is minor.
findings.recommended_fix: Mirror the weight check: reject when fid > u64(max(u32)) before the cast, fail loud at parse like the weight values (and ideally the sibling emphasis/lane/preview directives).

findings.title: Fast-path validate→apply→log→toast block duplicated 4x in qos_panel.odin (3x byte-identical for the same command kind)
findings.detail: The same block is copied byte-identically at app/qos_panel.odin:228-237 and :251-260 (both Cmd_Set_Emphasis) and shaped-same at :155-164 (Cmd_Set_Lane); main.odin holds four more sites (:645, :705, :881, :899). The E10 logging convention is single-sourced nowhere.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract one helper, e.g. app_emit_cmd(app: ^App, cmd: pp.Command) -> bool wrapping validate→apply→append(action_log)→reject-toast; route the four qos_panel emit sites (and later main.odin's) through it.

findings.title: serialize.odin version-history block and tag-table comment not extended for the LOG_VERSION 4 weights payload
findings.evidence: core/serialize.odin:15-19: `// Story 1.2 bumps LOG_VERSION to 2: the command record is now Cmd_Draw_Pipe` / `// {a, b, tier} (was the 1.1 placeholder Cmd_Set_Arg{arg}). A v1 log is rejected` / `// by the v2 reader -> every 1.1 golden log is re-blessed with this story.` / `// Story 3.5 bumps LOG_VERSION to 3: Cmd_Place_Router joins the set (the` — no 5.8 entry. core/serialize.odin:56: `CMD_TAG_SET_EMPHASIS :: u8(5)  // 3.2 — set a pipe's lane-weight preset (the dial)`.
findings.detail: Both prior bumps appended a history entry; 5.8's bump is documented only at the constant (line 463). The tag-5 comment still describes the retired preset/dial payload — the record now carries 3xi32 weights.
findings.recommended_fix: Append the 5.8-to-4 entry to the header history block (same format: bump reason + re-bless rationale) and update the CMD_TAG_SET_EMPHASIS comment to the weights payload.
